steps.title: Where a component runs

steps.prompt: Which can a Server Component NOT do?

options.text: Use useState, useEffect or onClick handlers
options.textTr: useState, useEffect ya da onClick handler'ları kullanmak
Bir veritabanı sorgusunu doğrudan await etmek

options.text: Render without shipping JS to the client
Read a file from the filesystem

steps.explanation: Server Components have no interactivity — no state, effects, or event handlers. Those require a Client Component ("use client"). Server Components can fetch data and read files directly.
steps.explanationTr: Server Component'lerin etkileşimi yoktur — state, effect ya da event handler yok. Bunlar bir Client Component ("use client") gerektirir. Server Component'ler doğrudan veri çekip dosya okuyabilir.

steps.prompt: Mark this file as a Client Component so it can use useState
steps.promptTr: Bu dosyayı, useState kullanabilmesi için Client Component olarak işaretle
steps.explanation: The exact string directive "use client" at the very top opts the module (and its imports) into the client bundle, enabling hooks and event handlers.
steps.explanationTr: En üstteki tam string direktifi "use client", modülü (ve import'larını) istemci bundle'ına alır, hook ve event handler'ları etkinleştirir.

When do you use 'use client' directive in Next.js?

steps.title: APIs and where data is loaded

steps.prompt: How do you typically fetch data in an App Router page?
steps.promptTr: App Router'da bir sayfada veriyi tipik olarak nasıl çekersin?

options.text: await it directly inside an async Server Component
options.textTr: async bir Server Component içinde doğrudan await ederek

options.text: Only via useEffect on the client

steps.explanation: App Router Server Components are async — you await fetch/db calls right in the component. getServerSideProps/getStaticProps belong to the Pages Router.
steps.explanationTr: App Router Server Component'leri async'tir — fetch/db çağrılarını doğrudan bileşende await edersin. getServerSideProps/getStaticProps Pages Router'a aittir.

steps.statement: A route.ts file in the App Router exports functions named after HTTP methods like GET and POST.
steps.statementTr: App Router'da bir route.ts dosyası GET ve POST gibi HTTP metodlarına göre adlandırılmış fonksiyonlar export eder.
steps.explanation: Route Handlers export GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc., using the Web Request/Response APIs — the App Router replacement for pages/api endpoints.
steps.explanationTr: Route Handler'lar Web Request/Response API'lerini kullanarak GET, POST, PUT, DELETE vb. export eder — pages/api endpoint'lerinin App Router karşılığı.
